 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Combine two 4x4 color masks separated by the 5 divider.

    If the nonzero masks are disjoint, overlay them. If they collide, retain
    the left-hand mask (as illustrated by the demonstrations).
    """
    left = [row[:4] for row in grid[:4]]
    right = [row[5:9] for row in grid[:4]]
    collision = any(left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0
                    for r in range(4) for c in range(4))
    if collision:
        return left
    return [[left[r][c] if left[r][c] != 0 else right[r][c]
             for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
